title: Open Multi-Agent (OMA) Framework
summary: A goal-driven TypeScript orchestration engine for building autonomous multi-agent teams. It dynamically decomposes high-level goals into task directed acyclic graphs (DAGs) and executes them with parallelization and synthesis.
research_notes: Maintains a 'three runtime dependencies' rule for extreme portability and positions itself as the TypeScript-native, goal-first alternative to LangGraph.

evolution.summary: Evolved from a simple role-play experiment into a production-ready 'Goal-to-DAG' orchestration framework. Major updates include MCP integration, context isolation for security, and strict token budgeting for enterprise use.
